lane: ينبث ينبيث يَنْبِيث A kind of sea-fish: (IAar, T:) different from the بَيْنِيث: it is doubtful whether it be Arabic, or a foreign word introduced into the Arabic language. (T.) [See arts. بنث and نبث.]
